description: Correct wrong-SSID routing, canonical reassignment session handling, and pending admin notification retry

post_update.description: Rebuild the captive portal web image to activate the corrected SSID reassignment workflow and administrator notification retry
post_update.notes: The wrong-SSID page is the only page that offers the network-change action. Pending requests are matched to the exact destination VLAN; an existing matching request can resend its administrator notification without creating a duplicate. No database migration or Nginx Proxy Manager update is required.

post_rollback.description: Rebuild the captive portal web image after rolling back this update
post_rollback.notes: Only the web service needs rebuilding for these portal source/template changes.

notes: The manifest is named for the current starting commit 1d7eb6a and is intended to be committed with the next firmware revision.
